formatNotes: Format overhaul: 20 scored events for 30 men and 30 women across four competition days - July 22, 24, 25, and 26 - with no individual events on Thursday, July 23; the most events in a single Games in the sport's history. Day 1 (July 22) sent the field off-site for seven events at The Ranch in Aromas and the Morgan Hill Outdoor Complex, headlined by a reprised 2007 Hopper and the return of the CrossFit Total, whose three lifts (back squat, shoulder press, deadlift) are each scored as separate events worth a reduced points scale versus a standard event. Event 7 (Swim Standard), along with later events 9, 10, 16, and 17, stream exclusively on FloElite rather than the main CrossFit Games broadcast.
yearSummary: The 2026 Games are underway in San Jose, the arena days moving to SAP Center after two years in Fort Worth and Albany, with a record 20 scored events spread across four competition days and no individual events on the Thursday rest day. Day 1 sent both divisions off-site for seven events: a rerun of the inaugural 2007 Hopper, a 7,200-meter trail run at The Ranch, all three lifts of the CrossFit Total scored as separate events, a grass-oval bike race, and a pool swim/burpee event exclusive to FloElite. Jay Crouch, who won the reprised Hopper opener alongside his fiancee Madeline Sturt, held the men's overall lead wire-to-wire through six events before the closing pool swim flipped the top of the leaderboard. Aimee Cringle was the story of the women's field, winning three of the seven Day 1 events - the trail run, the CrossFit Total deadlift, and the bike race.

events.name: The 2007 Hopper
events.description:
For time:
1,000-meter row
5 rounds of:
25 pull-ups
7 push jerks

Push jerk: 135 lb men / 85 lb women. A rerun of The Hopper, the event that opened the inaugural 2007 CrossFit Games. Contested off-site on Day 1; exact site not officially specified. No published time cap.
events.notes: Crouch and Sturt are an engaged couple and both won the reprised opener. The original 2007 Hopper produced winning times of 13:07 (Marshall) for the men and 16:22 (Gentry) for the women; both 2026 winners nearly halved those times.

events.name: Ranch 7200
events.description:
For time:
7,200-meter trail run

Contested at The Ranch, Aromas, California. No published time cap.
events.notes: Garard, who won both parts of the 2024 Track and Field running event at Farrington Field outright, confirmed his standing as the field's premier runner; steep climbs at The Ranch forced some athletes to walk sections of the course.

events.name: The CrossFit Total - Back Squat
events.description:
Establish a 1-rep-max back squat, the first of three lifts in the reprised CrossFit Total (back squat, shoulder press, deadlift), each scored as its own event on a reduced points scale.

Score: load. No published time cap.

events.name: The CrossFit Total - Shoulder Press
events.description:
Establish a 1-rep-max strict shoulder press, the second of three lifts in the CrossFit Total.

Score: load. No published time cap.

events.name: The CrossFit Total - Deadlift
events.description:
Establish a 1-rep-max deadlift, the third and final lift of the CrossFit Total.

Score: load. No published time cap.
events.notes: Colten Mertens' 1,380 lb Total (555/260/565 lb) and Alex Gazan's 920 lb Total (330/170/420 lb) were reported by BoxRox as CrossFit Games CrossFit Total records; Patrick Vellner won the deadlift event at age 36.

events.name: Grass Oval Bicycle Race
events.description:
For time:
20 laps of a grass oval track

Contested at the Morgan Hill Outdoor Complex. Time cap: 25 minutes.
events.notes: The men's finish was a photo finish, the top five within 0.76 seconds of each other; Fiebig beat Pepper by 0.14 seconds. First Games cycling event since the 2023 Ride. Cringle's third event win of the day, after the trail run and the CrossFit Total deadlift.

events.name: Swim Standard
events.description:
For time:
200-meter swim
40 burpees
150-meter swim
30 burpees
100-meter swim
20 burpees
50-meter swim
10 burpees

25-meter pool presented by TYR, at the Morgan Hill Outdoor Complex. Time cap: 15 minutes.
events.notes: The first swim event at the Games since 2022's Rinse 'N' Repeat pool intervals, which Lucy Campbell also won; Morgan Hill also hosted the 2020 Games swim. Campbell, a former competitive swimmer, won by 69 seconds; Ty Jenkins' win was his first career individual event victory, at age 20. Streamed exclusively on FloElite.

events.name: Climbing Snail '26
events.description:
For time, wearing a weight vest (22 lb men / 16 lb women):
400-lb Snail push (100 feet men / 60 feet women)
Legless rope climbs (3 men / 2 women)
30 toes-to-bars
Rope climbs (5 men / 4 women)
Closing Snail push
10-minute time cap.
events.notes: First Snail at the Games since the 2016 Climbing Snail. Khrennikov won by nearly a minute for his sixth career event win, then gave his first victory interview delivered entirely in English. Alex Gazan won the women's event (4:55.22, on the women's course of shorter Snail pushes and fewer climbs) for her second event win of the 2026 Games.

events.name: 3D Throw
events.description:
For total distance, three sandbag throws (30 lb men / 20 lb women):
1 throw with the right foot forward
1 throw with the left foot forward
1 overhead backward throw
Distance measured from the back of the bag; throws landing outside the lane incur a 10-foot penalty. Scored as a 50-point event.
events.notes: First throw-for-distance test at the Games since the 2012 GHD Ball Toss. A 50-point event (the first 50-point events since 2016 per the broadcast, alongside the CrossFit Total). Malheiros won for his sixth career event win - one of his five priors was the 2022 Sandbag Ladder. Vellner and Dylan Hamming tied for second at 122 ft. James Sprague slipped on his final throw (16th), costing him the overall lead to Dallin Pepper. Abigail Domit won the women's event (108 ft) for her first career event win, ahead of Hannah Black (106 ft) and Alex Gazan (100 ft).

events.name: Run Hang Squat Clean
events.description:
4 rounds for time of:
660-meter run
10 hang squat cleans (225 lb men / 155 lb women, short barbell)
15-minute time cap.
events.notes: Runs exited the SAP Center onto an outdoor course. Crouch won by 13+ seconds for his second win of these Games (third career), with Medeiros edging Adler by 0.40s for second; Garard led early but a no-rep on his final round-three rep sank his event. Sprague finished 15:00.07 to Pepper 15:19.14, retaking the overall lead 614-607 - the second lead change of the day. Lawson won the women's event ahead of Campbell, who retook 2nd overall from Sturt (10th in the event) - that battle flipped three times on Friday.

events.name: Handstand Sprint
events.description:
For time: handstand walk course across the arena floor.
6-minute time cap.
events.notes: Name recalls the 2020 Handstand Sprint (Fraser/Wells). Victor Hoffer - who trained French artistic gymnastics from age three - won by nearly 25 seconds for his first career Games event win. Malheiros took his second podium of the day; New Zealand rookie Ben Fowler took his first career podium. After officials revised scoring, Sprague (14th in the event) retained the overall lead at 664 over Medeiros 648, Crouch 644 and Pepper 642 - a 22-point spread across the top four entering the hopper closer. Paige Rodgers won the women's event (1:56.58) for her first career event win; Danielle Brandon - winner of three straight handstand-family events 2021-2023 - finished outside the top ten. Rookie Lydia Fish took 3rd on an injured foot, part of an injured-ankle trio (Fish, Raptis, Greer) sweeping 3rd-5th. Lawson's 6th vaulted her from 5th to 2nd overall as Sturt fell to 5th - the women's podium picture reshuffled for the fourth time in the day.

events.name: The Hopper 2026
events.description:
Drawn live from the original 2007 hopper drum at Opening Ceremonies (snatch + toes-to-bar), structure set by fan vote:
3 rounds for time of:
21 toes-to-bars
7 unbroken power snatches
7 unbroken hang snatches
7 unbroken squat snatches
(95 lb men / 65 lb women)
6-minute time cap.
events.notes: The first hopper-drawn Games event since 2007, using the original drum. Unbroken snatch sets required (a dropped bar restarted the set). Mertens won for his third event win of the 2026 Games; Crouch 2nd, reigning champion Hopper 3rd, and Sprague 4th to retain the overall lead at the end of Day 2 (752 over Crouch 740, Medeiros 732, Pepper 718). Lucy Campbell won the women's event (5:02.48) for her sixth career event win - the workout was programmed by Tia-Clair Toomey and its structure chosen by fan vote. Cringle's finish-line buzzer initially failed to register; the official review credited her 4th (5:05), which moved Lawson to 5th on the event and decided 2nd overall: Campbell 739 edged Lawson 734, the fourth flip of second place in a single day. Cringle ended Day 2 at 826, an 87-point lead.

events.name: 500 Run
events.notes: 500m street sprint on Barack Obama Boulevard outside SAP Center, two turns, heats of 15. A 50-point event (half value). Men (official broadcast results; API board pending at time of entry): Garard 1:13.09 over Malheiros 1:13.31 and Souza 1:13.98 - Garard talked to Malheiros mid-race and had the win eased up before the line. Women (official board, 29/30 scored): Cringle 1:20.98 - her FOURTH event win of these Games (after three on Day 1: the Ranch 7200, the Total deadlift and the bicycle race) and her first since Wednesday - over rookie Noel 1:21.31 and Wirz 1:22.05. The win pushed her lead to 108; behind her Lawson (9th) edged Campbell (12th) to retake 2nd overall by ONE point, 768-767, the fifth flip of the silver race.
events.description: 500-meter street sprint on Barack Obama Boulevard outside SAP Center: three straightaways, two turns, run in heats of 15. A 50-point (half-value) event.

events.name: Triple Pig
events.description: 3 ascending rounds for time: 10/15/20 bar muscle-ups, 15/20/25 GHD sit-up wall-ball shots (20/14 lb), 20/25/30 triple-unders (a Games first), 1/2/3 Pig flips at 510/350 lb - the same Pig weight as the 2021 Sled, Pig, Muscle-Ups and the 2023 Pig Chipper. 15-minute cap.
events.notes: Triple-unders had zero Games precedent. Men (official broadcast results; API pending at entry): Vellner 10:31.58 - winning at the exact Pig weight he won at in 2021, our history-first pick - over Pepper 10:46.91 and overall leader Sprague 11:11.25, while title rival Crouch took 10th (12:54.44). Khrennikov (2023 Pig Chipper champion) 6th. Women (official board, 30/30): CRINGLE 10:41.36 WON BY 1:47 - back-to-back wins two hours after the sprint - her fourth and fifth event wins of these Games (three came on Day 1), her first two since Wednesday - over Milligan 12:28.34 and Loewen 12:43.09 (2nd at this weight in 2023). The Pig capped 16 of 30 women and ate two top-5 spots: Sturt 27th (CAP+154), Gazan 29th (CAP+161); the silver gap exploded from 1 point to 36 (Lawson 848, Campbell 812).

events.name: 2020 Speed Snatch
events.description: Rerun of the 2020 speed snatch ladder: three bracket-elimination rounds of three ascending bars, all racing simultaneously. Round 1: 145/150/155 lb women, 1-min cap, top 20 times advance. Round 2: 160/165/170, 2-min cap, top 10 advance. Final: 175/180/185 women (men heavier), 3-min cap, winner take all.
events.notes: Both No. 1 model picks delivered: Malheiros (2021 max-snatch champion at 305 lb) won the men final in 21.27 over Magda 24.42 and Martin 26.26 - his redemption arc in one day: sprint 2nd by 0.22, knocked from the top 10 by the Pig, then an event win. Hannah Black (heaviest listed snatch in the women field, 231) took her first career win in 20.55 over Kerstetter 23.09 and Fuliano 24.94 - the 10th first-time event winner of the 2026 Games - after 19-year-old Bergros Bjornsdottir, youngest in the field, led her to the final bar and missed 185 on a shoulder-check (broadcast). Cringle, Campbell and Lawson all missed the women final; Cringle 13th still kept a 120-point lead and became the first athlete past 1,000 points. Pepper went 4th on the men side, backing up his Pig 2nd after a rough 23rd on the sprint.

events.name: Echo Thruster
events.description: 21-18-15 reps for time of Echo bike calories and short-bar thrusters climbing per round (115/135/155 lb men, 85/95/105 lb women). 8-minute cap. The bike-and-thruster core of the 2023 Echo Thruster Final at identical loads; 2023 finished with a lunge, 2026 hands off to Event 17 on the same running clock instead.
events.notes: The receipt cashed: Pepper, the 2023 Echo Thruster Final champion, won the rerun at 4:55.43 - our picks board fifth hit of the day (Garard E13, Vellner E14, Loewen podium, Malheiros E15, Pepper E16). Sprague answered with 2nd at 5:18.14 in the tightest title race of the week; Hopper 3rd began a huge closing night. Women: Ellie Turner won 5:54.27 over Campbell 6:00.78 and von Rohr 6:07.74, one day after being time-capped twice - the comeback swing of the weekend.

events.name: Jump Pull Yoke
events.description: At the 10:00 mark of the Event 16 clock, for time: 20 shuttle box jumps (36/30 in), a seated sled pull (170/140 lb), then 30-foot yoke carries at three rising weights (425/565/665 lb men, 345/405/445 lb women). 6-minute cap; the 665-lb top yoke ties the heaviest ever loaded at the Games (2022 Back Nine).
events.notes: The leader finally took one: Sprague won in 3:20.65 - his FIRST event win of the 2026 Games (verified: zero wins through 16 while atop the board almost continuously since Event 7), closing Day 3 up 29 on Pepper. Henrik Haapalainen took 2nd at 3:38.09, days after publicly correcting our injury note - not hurt, just back. Hopper 3rd completed a 3rd-3rd evening that vaulted him to 5th overall. Women: Campbell won 3:16.21 (her third win: swim, hopper, yoke) over Kerstetter and Garnes to cap a 196-point evening that cut the silver gap to 33.

events.name: Machine 7200
events.description: For time: 3,600-meter row then 3,600-meter ski (alternating row/ski segments totaling 7,200 m of machine work). Time cap 30 min men / 35 min women. A pure engine test to open the final day.
events.notes: Sprague won wire to wire (24:22.46) - his second straight event win after the E17 yoke - leading off the rower and extending on the ski, stretching his overall lead over Pepper (4th) from 29 to 41 with two events left; he is bidding to be the first man to win titles in non-consecutive years. Hopper 2nd (third straight podium), Khrennikov 3rd. Adler, the 2025 machine-event winner, finished 11th - the pre-event history read did not hold. Women: Olivia Kerstetter won 27:36.00 over Campbell 27:46.37 and Adams 28:03.10, and the result detonated the silver race - Campbell 2nd while Lawson went 9th cut the gap from 33 points to FIVE (Lawson 1142, Campbell 1137) with the Fibonacci Final to decide it; Gazan (923) and Sturt (922) sit one point apart for 4th. Cringle 4th on the event, lead 136. Both prior machine-event winners in the field (Adler 2025, Mertens 2023) finished off the podium.
